_om: Golfballen in English (Birdie, rusj.no/en/birdie/): the Golf card game. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Mobilen beholder lave kort og kaster høy: The phone keeps low cards and throws high ones, without much of a plan. Good for little ones.
Mobilen regner ut hvor hvert kort gjør m: The phone works out where each card helps most, and looks for pairs.
Mobilen regner, holder på kort du venter: The phone does the maths, keeps the cards you're waiting for, and won't go out until it's ahead. Can you beat it?

The discards have been shuffled into a new pile.
Turn over two of your cards to begin.
Se på de to nederste kortene dine – og h: Look at your bottom two cards – and remember them.
Husk de to nederste kortene! De snus igj: Remember your bottom two cards! They turn back over when you're ready.
Turn over one of your hidden cards.
Trykk på kortet i rutenettet du vil bytt: Tap the card in your grid that you want to swap out.
Bytt med et kort i rutenettet – eller ka: Swap it with a card in your grid – or throw it away.
Trekk et kort, ta det øverste fra kasteb: Draw a card, take the top discard – or knock.
Trekk et kort, eller ta det øverste fra: Draw a card, or take the top discard.
{navn}: {apne} av {alle} kort åpne, {poe: {navn}: {apne} of {alle} cards face up, {poeng} points showing.
Kast kortet du trakk: Throw away the card you drew
Få lavest mulig sum. Alle har seks kort: Get the lowest score you can. Everyone has six cards face down in two rows (or four in a square) and swaps their way to lower cards, hole by hole.
Trekk det øverste kortet fra bunken, ell: Draw the top card from the pile, or take the top card of the discards.
Bytt kortet med ett av kortene dine – de: Swap the card with one of yours – the old one goes on the discards. A card you drew from the pile can also just be thrown away.
Når noen har alle kortene åpne, får de a: When someone has all their cards face up, everyone else gets one more turn and the hole is scored. After the last hole, the lowest total wins.
Poeng: ess 1, toer minus 2, tre til ti d: Points: ace 1, two minus 2, three to ten face value, jack and queen 10, king 0.
To like kort i samme kolonne – det ene o: Two equal cards in the same column – one above the other – count 0.
Seks kort: Snu to av kortene dine før di: Six cards: turn over two of your cards before your first turn.
Fire kort: Se på de to nederste kortene: Four cards: look at your bottom two cards once before your first turn – and remember them. New cards go face down. When you think your total is low enough, knock instead of drawing; everyone else then gets one more turn.
Husregel «Toer minus to»: Slår du den av: House rule ‘Twos are minus two’: switch it off and a two counts 2.
Husregel «Snu når du kaster» (seks kort): House rule ‘Turn when you throw’ (six cards): if you throw away the card you drew, turn over one of your hidden cards.
Flere på én mobil: Med seks kort er alt: Several on one phone: with six cards everything is out in the open, so just pass the phone on. With four cards the cards are hidden between turns.
Swap your way down to the lowest score.
Hvordan vil dere spille?: How do you want to play?
Fire kort med bildet ned: se på de to ne: Four cards face down: look at the bottom two once, remember them – and knock when you're ahead.
Seks kort i to rader. Snu to – resten fi: Six cards in two rows. Turn over two – the rest you'll find out as you go.
Ni hull er en hel runde. Lavest sum til: Nine holes is a full round. The lowest total at the end wins.
En toer gir minus 2 poeng. Av: toeren te: A two scores minus 2. Off: a two counts 2.
Kaster du kortet du trakk, snur du ett a: If you throw away the card you drew, turn over one of your hidden cards.
Godt kjempa! Neste gang triller ballen d: Good effort! Next time the ball rolls your way.
Bytt eller kast kortet du har: Swap or throw away the card you have
De andre får én tur hver, og så telles h: Everyone else gets one more turn, and then the hole is scored.
